Portfolio prototype — not engineering software. The interactive conversion is a geometric 2.5D illustration of your strokes, not a true 3D solid, AI-generated CAD model, dimensionally accurate blueprint, or construction-ready plan. A production version would require an AI/CAD backend, geometric validation, and professional engineering review for physical builds.

03 / MAKE

Print-ready output

This demo exports and prints illustrative vector blueprints; a real product could offer validated CAD files, scaled plans, and professional drawings.
